title: Hold a breeding licence to breed dogs or cats
what: Breed a litter from a dog or cat only while holding a breeding licence.

sources.title: Domestic Animals Act 2000 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 72(1) (current republication (R51, from 16 November 2025; Domestic Animals Act 2000 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person— (a) is a keeper or carer of a dog or cat; and (b) breeds a litter from the dog or cat; and (c) does not hold a breeding licence

sources.title: Domestic Animals Act 2000 (ACT)
